calls.statement:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.subcategory AS sub_asof, cp.subcategory AS sub_current, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
    AND (p.subcategory='Interior Paint' OR cp.subcategory='Interior Paint') AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT sub_asof, sub_current, count(*) line_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl, sum(quantity) units, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM base GROUP BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date d, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc, sum(f.quantity) u
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT * FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=108 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'),
cal AS (SELECT calendar_date, is_trading_day, holiday_name FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02')
SELECT c.calendar_date, c.is_trading_day, f.net, r.net_sales_before_returns, f.rc, r.receipts, f.u, r.units_sold
FROM cal c LEFT JOIN f ON f.d=c.calendar_date LEFT JOIN r ON r.business_date=c.calendar_date
WHERE f.net IS DISTINCT FROM r.net_sales_before_returns OR f.u IS DISTINCT FROM r.units_sold OR f.rc IS DISTINCT FROM r.receipts
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'sales_qty_dist' k, quantity::VARCHAR a, count(*)::VARCHAR b, ''::VARCHAR c FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_booked_in_P3_at_108', cp.subcategory, sum(r.quantity_returned)::VARCHAR, count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_of_P3_sold_lines', cp.subcategory, sum(r.quantity_returned)::VARCHAR, count(*)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=108 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND cp.subcategory='Interior Paint' GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL

calls.statement:
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period AS period, s.store_id, s.store_name, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND cp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
